Load a habitat export into PostgreSQL

Source: R/lnk_db_load.R
lnk_db_load.Rd

Fetches the parts a catalog lists, checks each one's size and md5 against the manifest before reading it, and writes their rows to one table, keyed (config, species, blue_line_key, downstream_route_measure). Join it to whse_basemapping.fwa_stream_networks_sp by blue_line_key and measure to cut each segment's line.

Usage

lnk_db_load(
  conn,
  catalog,
  configs = NULL,
  table = "habitat.fwa_v1_segment",
  cache_dir = tools::R_user_dir("link", "cache")
)

Arguments

conn

A DBI connection to PostgreSQL.

catalog

A catalog from lnk_catalog(), optionally filtered to some of its parts. A config is loaded from the parts given for it, so filter by config rather than by species when reloading.

configs

Configs to load, or NULL for every config in catalog.

table

Target table, schema.table. Defaults to the name the dataset ID gives, habitat.fwa_v1_segment.

cache_dir

Where downloaded parts are kept. A cached part is reused while its md5 still matches the manifest. Local parts are read in place.

Value

Invisibly, a data frame of key and rows loaded.

Details

Everything runs in one transaction: a part that fails its md5, a column mismatch, a duplicate key or a short read leaves the table as it was. Loading a config replaces that config's rows (all species), so a reload never mixes two builds of one config. Other configs' rows are untouched.

See also

Other export: lnk_catalog(), lnk_scenario_export()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
conn <- lnk_db_conn(dbname = "fwapg", host = "localhost", port = 5432L,
                    user = "postgres", password = "postgres")
cat <- lnk_catalog("s3://fresh-bc/habitat/fwa/v1/manifest.json")
lnk_db_load(conn, cat, configs = "default")

DBI::dbGetQuery(conn, "
  SELECT species, round(sum(length_metre) / 1000) AS rearing_km
    FROM habitat.fwa_v1_segment
   WHERE config = 'default' AND rearing
   GROUP BY species")
} # }
